base: Thirty-six stories verified for v1/v2 (see stories_v2.md); v3 keeps the v2 set exactly and renumbers it for the illustrated layout
notes: For every story, source_url is null: v1/v2 logged outlet and date, not links, and none was invented afterwards. Two stories were first reported on 24 Nov ([23] Gaza strike, [24] Iraq sackings, both Reuters) and are kept exactly as v2 listed them, per the build brief. No source-stated UTC clock time exists for any story in the v2 record, so the image carries no clock-time timeline. v3 rebuild on 26 Nov 2026 follows the winner-template layout: 13 illustrated scenes drawn fresh (3 leads plus 10 small ones), a freshly drawn pin-matched world map, dense ALSO briefs 14-36, a date-check list of excluded stories, and a HOW SURE legend. entry_v3.png is 1024x990, 661667 bytes.
